original_test_intent: Verify the functional Port Type classification encoded by every SMBIOS Type 8 connector record, correlate it with that record's internal/external connector endpoints, and prove the mapping persists after reboot. This is distinct from checking either connector's physical form-factor enum.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 8 records, preserve each raw Port Type enum with handle and both endpoint designators/types, compare the functional classification to the approved port inventory, then repeat after an approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected functional port map, enum exception policy and reboot plan. Optional cable, peripheral or live-link testing is separate and does not change this metadata case's capability.
required_inputs: Expected Port Type enum per Type 8 record
Board/chassis revision and functional port inventory
Expected internal/external designators and connector types for record identity
Applicable SMBIOS version and policy for Other/Unknown/vendor values
Validated parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not connect/disconnect cables or attach devices.
Preserve the raw Port Type enum and full record because decoded wording can vary and identical connector shapes can serve different functions.
Do not substitute Internal or External Connector Type for Port Type; the fields express different semantics.
Do not claim live protocol operation, link speed or physical population from Type 8 metadata.
Stop on malformed/unsupported enum, identity mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect every Type 8 record, decode raw Port Type values using the applicable definition and compare each complete connector identity before/after reboot.
Do not touch ports, perform functional device tests or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the functional port inventory and enum/exception policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize any separate functional-link test if desired, and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field selector is relevant, but grep-only output cannot distinguish records and omits endpoint identity and raw enum; it may also match context inconsistently.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 8 records and validate each raw Port Type enum with handle, both endpoint designators/types and approved functional-port identity before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Port Type scope, Type 8 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare each raw Port Type enum and decoded functional label against a version-aware project inventory while binding it to both connector endpoints and retaining complete pre/post-reboot records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/chassis revision and dmidecode/parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 8 Port Type enumeration, approved board/chassis functional-port inventory and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum provenance and explicitly separates functional port role from connector form factor and live-link testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; catches incorrect functional classifications even when connector types appear plausible.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Functional port map, full Type 8 endpoint identity and version-aware enum policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Port Type metadata does not prove electrical connectivity, protocol negotiation or device operation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve board-specific functional port assignments or documented Other values, but must bind them to exact records and cannot use this metadata result as a substitute for a separate link/function test.
expected_evidence: Approved board/chassis revision, functional port inventory, SMBIOS version and enum exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 8 table with handle, raw/decoded Port Type and both endpoint designators/types
Per-record functional classification result distinct from connector-form-factor checks
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot table/diff
Engineer verdict; optional live-link evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the Type 8 Port Type field and reboot persistence; it does not require physical or live-link acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Port Type is deterministically readable and comparable once the project map is approved; missing inputs do not create a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds full endpoint identity, raw enum and functional-versus-form-factor distinction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-port-manipulation safeguards while correcting software metadata capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps optional link testing and engineer verdict separate from execution readiness and automation classification.

review_improvement: Prevents a connector shape from being mistaken for its functional Port Type and prevents isolated duplicate labels from being misattributed.
independent_technical_reasoning: Port Type is a discrete SMBIOS enum within a complete Type 8 record; version-aware decoding, mapping and persistence comparison are automatable software operations.
